answer: An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 154 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, as the declared depth is published in the glacier receipt and checked against the ivory nonce, so a padded text pays the fee and is refused anyway. Since the reef audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
